svg.title: Public clocks in the PHP emergency, as read on 22 October 2026
svg.desc: A not-to-scale sequence from an Amazon-reported 17 October honeypot attempt, through PHP's 20 October advance notice, early attack and Cloudflare protection claims on 21 October, CERT-EU's reported 13:30 fix release, the scheduled 14:00 embargo lift, selected official image publication, and a selected Drupal image read on 22 October.
svg.text: Ordered by first stated time; windows may overlap · not to scale · UTC

g.text: Amazon later reports a honeypot exploit attempt
Cloudflare says default WAF protection starts, 03:02
CERT-EU fixes 13:30 · AWS embargo 14:00 · images later
Selected Drupal image seen with fixed PHP base layers

svg.text: Sources: Amazon, PHP, CERT-EU, Cloudflare, Docker Hub; read 21–22 Oct. Clocks and limits in records.
